Iran Vows to Counter US Naval Blockade with 'All Available Means'

Iran has stated it will employ 'all available means' and 'all tools' to confront the United States' naval blockade and defend itself. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs indicated that measures are being taken to break the blockade, with one report characterizing it as an 'act of war'. The situation involves Iran's oil trade, with one outlet referencing a potential 'China Oil Gamble' and an 'Operation Fereydoun' aimed at breaking the blockade.
